interpretation: Diagnostic lower bounds only. Overlapping object omissions and quantity errors must not be summed as independent accuracy errors. Foreign restaurant receipts are outside the Korean grocery prompt scope. Thermometer is allowed by current household-product wording. Ambiguous identities and hidden counts remain ungraded.
